title: LxSpawn
description: A lightweight spawn plugin packed with fun features!
body:
#  LxSpawn - The only Spawn-Plugin you'll need!

![LxSpawn picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0db459eb6779615591f626bd899ffb9f253e29eb_0.webp)

---

<details>
<summary>Why LxSpawn?</summary>
LxSpawn is lightweight and built for performance. You won't expirience any lag on your server, and bugs are fixed by the developer as soon as possible.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Cool Features</summary>
LxSpawn includes many great features, such as a Parkour System and Double Jump. There are also fun Jumppads that admins can place around the map. You'll never fall into the void again - the plugin automatically teleports you back to spawn as soon as you fall to far!
</details>


<details>
<summary>Fun all around the Lobby</summary>
LxSpawn offers fun features that make your lobby more enjoyable.
Share your suggestions anytime — the goal is to make it the best chill lobby plugin!
</details>

---

### What does it offer?

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>
USER COMMANDS
  
- /spawn - Teleports you to Spawn
- /fly - Enables/Disables flying mode

---

ADMIN COMMANDS
- /setspawn - Set the global Spawn-Point
- /setstart - Set the startpoint of the parkour
- /setend - Set the endpoint of the parkour
- /givejump - Gives you a Jumppad

</details>


<details>
<summary>Permissions</summary>
  
- ```lxspawn.doublejump``` – Allows players to use Double Jump.
- ```lxspawn.givejump``` – Grants access to Jump Pads.
- ```lxspawn.setend``` – Sets the end point of a Parkour course.
- ```lxspawn.setspawn``` – Sets the server spawn location.
- ```lxspawn.setstart``` – Sets the start point of a Parkour course.
- ```lxspawn.spawn``` – Teleports players to spawn.

</details>
